congeneric_series: Analogous ligands sharing a core scaffold in a SAR series.
共享核心骨架的一组药化修饰配体，是防泄漏评估的独立结构单位。
fail_closed: Fail-Closed Gate / 默认闭门护栏
Missing prerequisites or unconfirmed research choices hard-block downstream runs.
缺失前置确认或校验证据时显式拒绝执行，绝不静默跳过或代填决策。
censored_ki: Upper/lower assay bounds rather than exact singleton intervals.
带不等号界限的测量记录，与精确点值严格区分，禁止插补为精确靶标差。
delta_p: Affinity difference pKd/pKi(Target) - pKd/pKi(Off-target) on a fixed panel.
同一配体在固定目标靶点与反靶点之间的选择性差值。
test_exposure: Immutable append-only log tracking every access to final_test splits across protocol freezes.
跨协议版本追查 final_test 预登记与实际读取时间的只增不改审计日志。
carryover_reconciliation: Every unfinished item from week N-1 must map to a task in week N or a reasoned backlog entry.
周报承接对账机制，严禁静默丢失未完成任务。
